t: A tiny Google board that runs vision and voice AI on a chip.
steps: Buy the board from a distributor such as Mouser or RS Components.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the Coral board package.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the person detection example and upload it.
Wave at the camera and watch the result on the serial monitor.
Try the keyword example with the onboard microphone.
Hold the User button and press Reset if flashing fails, then try again.
Move to the coralmicro SDK on Linux or macOS for bigger C++ projects.
meta: Open Board. From $74.95. A few stores.
